subject: ADVI: lp__ is 0 and there is no extra sample for the mode

messages.author: fb40a65bd21dcf6f
messages.subject: ADVI: lp__ is 0 and there is no extra sample for the mode
parts: Hi, AFAICT if I ask for the rstan::vb() method (version 2.9.0-3) for 1000 samples I get 1000 samples. I'm sure I used to get an extra one representing the mode of the posterior. Has the behaviour changed? Also the lp__ parameter is 0 for all the samples, should that be the case? Thanks, John.

messages.author: 49e107cb0f8a3d27
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ADVI: lp__ is 0 and there is no extra sample for the mode
parts:
Hi John, The output of ADVI is the posterior mean estimates along with drawn samples. I don’t think RStan outputs the posterior mean; you have to get it in a more roundabout way through taking the empirical mean of the samples. (Maybe this should change)

The lp__ parameter is intentionally set to 0 for all samples. There were arguments for and against this. The argument for is that unlike MCMC, ADVI has to take additional computation time to calculate it (it draws samples and does all this post processing after its optimization); this can be expensive especially in the settings where ADVI is supposed to be much faster than MCMC but would be bottlenecked by the many log_prob calls after the fact. The argument against is to be compatible with the output of MCMC.

Hope that helps.

Dustin

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] ADVI: lp__ is 0 and there is no extra sample for the mode
parts:
You're getting the unconstrained parameters, so no values are outside
the constraints. Then the inverse transforms are guaranteed to produce
well-constrained results (up to numerical issues like underflow/overflow).

- Bob

parts:
On Monday, March 14, 2016 at 1:15:37 PM UTC-4, John Reid wrote:
Can I just get this straight? The CSV file contains samples from the unconstrained space? rstan should be returning these samples by something is going wrong? I notice you made a fix as a result of my issue https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/278 Does this fix the problem and will the fix be in the next release of rstan?

The CSV file --- which is in tempdir() --- only contains parameter values in the constrained space. However, the lp__ thing in the first column was throwing what is returned by get_inits() off-by-one. This is fixed on GitHub, so you could install that or it will be in the next release of rstan.

Ben
